security_audit.summary: Most SKILL.md external command findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and fenced examples. The real risks are the Bash PreToolUse hook and persistent hidden Claude configuration under project or home paths. No evidence found for prompt injection, network access, credential access, or data exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: Global hidden Claude settings can affect every project.
remediation.suggestion: Default to project installation, require explicit confirmation for global installation, and provide uninstall steps before changing home Claude settings.

remediation.issue: Project hook installation changes persistent hidden configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Show the target settings diff, preserve existing hooks, and ask confirmation before writing project Claude settings or hook files.

remediation.issue: The Bash hook can fail open if it cannot inspect a command.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the script minimal, validate jq exists, handle parse failures safely, and fail closed when command inspection is unavailable.

content.user_title: Block Dangerous Git Commands in Claude Code
content.value_statement: AI coding assistants can accidentally run destructive Git commands during automated work. This skill adds Claude Code hooks that block risky Git operations before execution.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation of a Claude Code PreToolUse hook for Bash commands.
Blocks push, force push, hard reset, clean, branch delete, checkout dot, and restore dot patterns.
Supports project scoped and global Claude Code settings.
Shows how to merge with existing Claude Code hook settings.
Includes a verification step that checks a blocked Git push command.
limitations: It protects Claude Code Bash tool use, not every Git client on the machine.
It depends on the copied hook script remaining installed and executable.
Pattern matching can miss unusual command forms or aliases.
Global installation changes hidden home configuration for all Claude Code projects.

use_cases.title: Protect Solo Development
use_cases.description: Add project guardrails that stop an assistant from pushing, cleaning, or hard resetting local work.

use_cases.title: Standardize Repository Safety
use_cases.description: Use a shared project hook so Claude Code follows the same Git safety policy across a team repository.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Controls
use_cases.description: Inspect the hook, settings path, and blocked patterns before enabling AI assisted repository work.

prompt_templates.title: Install Project Guardrails
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up this skill for the current project only. Ask before editing settings, then add the hook and verify it blocks Git push.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Safe Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare project and global installation for my repository. Recommend the safer scope and explain which files will change.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Blocked Commands
prompt_templates.scenario: Adapt the hook to a stricter local policy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Install the project hook and add blocking for rebase abort and tag deletion. Preserve existing Claude Code hooks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit And Harden Settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing hook setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing Claude Code hook settings, merge this guardrail safely, and create a verification checklist for bypass cases.

output_examples.output: The assistant asks for confirmation, copies the hook into the project Claude folder, preserves existing settings, and verifies a blocked push.

output_examples.input: Customize the blocked Git operations for this repository.
output_examples.output: The assistant updates the copied hook patterns, explains the policy change, and runs a safe verification check.

output_examples.input: Review my current Claude Code hook setup.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes existing hooks, identifies conflicts, and recommends a safe merge plan before making changes.

best_practices: Prefer project scoped installation unless every repository needs the same policy.
Review the hook script and settings diff before enabling the guardrail.
Test blocked and allowed Git commands after any customization.
anti_patterns: Installing globally without explaining the change to the user.
Overwriting existing Claude Code hooks instead of merging settings.
Treating the guardrail as a substitute for repository permissions or branch protection.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Git commands?
faq.answer: No. It installs a hook that inspects proposed Bash commands and blocks selected Git patterns.

faq.question: Can I install it for one project?
faq.answer: Yes. The recommended scope is the project Claude settings file when only one repository needs protection.

faq.question: Can it protect all projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Global installation uses the home Claude settings path and affects all Claude Code projects.

faq.question: Which commands are blocked by default?
faq.answer: It blocks push, force push, hard reset, clean, branch delete, checkout dot, and restore dot patterns.

faq.question: Will it replace my existing hooks?
faq.answer: It should be merged into existing PreToolUse hooks without overwriting other settings.

faq.question: Is this enough for team Git safety?
faq.answer: No. Use it with branch protection, code review, and repository permissions.
